failure_modes.evidence: Sample size of only 9 patients is far too small to draw meaningful conclusions about efficacy. Standard Phase 2 trials in melanoma typically require 20-40 patients minimum.
Acral lentiginous melanoma is a distinct subtype that may be less responsive to checkpoint inhibition compared to cutaneous melanoma, where pembrolizumab has established efficacy.
